title: Kohler Mach Tripoint K-10UH00K30-CP 1.0 GPF Touchless Urinal Flushometer
writeup: Kohler's Mach Tripoint touchless urinal flushometer (K-10UH00K30-CP) runs on a hybrid energy cell rated for decades of use and flushes 1.0 gallon. It's a commercial-grade valve that plumbing suppliers sell for $723.30, and Woot has it for $358.99 while stock lasts.
